query: Which temporal aggregation windows (daily/weekly/monthly, rolling 30/90d) and normalization methods across repos/languages best capture meaningful developer behavior for modeling?

response.query: Which temporal aggregation windows (daily/weekly/monthly, rolling 30/90d) and normalization methods across repos/languages best capture meaningful developer behavior for modeling?
response.answer: For modeling developer behavior, daily and rolling 30/90-day aggregations, along with normalized metrics across repositories and languages, are most effective. These windows capture meaningful patterns while adjusting for variability.
